# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Trust in God in Time of Distress

---

**6:1** Blessed is the man whose heart is prepared to call upon the name of the LORD;
when he remembers the name of the LORD he will be saved.

**6:2** His ways are established by the LORD,
and the works of his hands are kept by God.

**6:3** His soul will not be terrified by an evil dream;
when he passes through rivers and surging waters he will not be troubled.

**6:4** He wakes from sleep and blesses the name of the LORD;
when his heart is at peace he sings praise to the name of his God.

**6:5** He asks mercy from the LORD for all his household;
and the LORD hears the prayer of all who fear him.

**6:6** May the LORD fulfill all the requests of those who fear him;
blessed are the devout of the LORD with his salvation.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA.*
